summary: Diagnosed the Phase 6b defect #4 (spine-tick basis mismatch) via cohort stratification and per-residual classification, then closed it by severance per Cooper's Amendment 8: primary-cohort criterion 1 passes at 92.0% (pooling with the deliberately-degraded 6-event sidecar was the earlier failure's cause, not a real defect); 5/7 residuals classified band_margin/coverage_gap; the diagnostic chart pack (Amendment 7) falsified the thinness mechanism for the remaining 2 (SCLX, VEEE) via an independent volume cross-check, and showed the defect isn't screenable by price-ratio checks at all (control AMC passes price but fails volume 10.06x). D4 permanently quarantines every spine numeric column from computation; SCLX/VEEE remain classified unexplained, closed by severance not explanation. Dev-tier tick-integrity spot-check: 0.0% true duplicate prints (strict key) across all 56 dev events.

decisions_log: T1: recompute A6.1's 3 criteria stratified by dev cohort (primary/sidecar/pooled), no threshold changes - resolved the pooling artifact.
T2: applied phase_6c.json's fixed classification rules literally to all 7 residuals; did not invent categories for SCLX/VEEE when they fit neither - escalated per protocol instead.
Amendment 7 (Cooper): upheld the T2 stop as correct; authorized a descriptive-only chart pack (no reclassification) to test 3 pre-registered predictions against SCLX/VEEE.

Amendment 8 (Cooper): gate outcome (b) - thinness mechanism falsified by the volume cross-check's direction. Recorded D4 (all spine numeric columns permanently quarantined from computation, superseding Amendment 5's price-only scope). Closed defect #4 by severance rather than continuing characterization.

T3'' escalation key: used the strict (event key + ts + price + size + sequence_number) duplicate definition, not the loose 4-tuple, since sequence_number exists in this table and same-tick/price/size prints with distinct sequence_number are ordinary distinct trades, not duplicates.
surprises: AMC - a control that PASSES the price-ratio check (rel_diff ~0) - still shows an incoherent volume factor (10.06x) against its price factor (5.24x), proving defect #4 cannot be screened out by any per-event price-agreement test, confirmed or residual.

SCLX/VEEE's volume ratios (35.1x, 13.8x) run in the OPPOSITE direction predicted by the coverage-gap hypothesis (which predicts a deficit, not a surplus) - a clean falsification rather than an ambiguous result.

The loose duplicate-print key (ts, price, size) alone would have flagged 8/56 dev events at >0.1%, but 100% of those collisions resolve to distinct sequence_number - a false-positive rate worth noting for any future phase reusing this check.
